hostile_review.caveat: Semantic refusal checks are deterministic boundary checks over frozen candidate notes and scopes; they do not invoke a narrator. The research layer has no narrator implementation, so the unknown-to-confident check verifies only that no assertion supplies such a predicate; the upstream production narrator remains to be tested in Gate B.

Regional leading-hemisphere NaCl interpretation does not establish global, subsurface or ocean abundance.
USGS global map is generalized at global scale and explicitly reports incomplete regional-resolution coverage.
